question: The average gini recalculated of the world in 2015
query: SELECT AVG(gini_recalculated) FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015 LIMIT 50;
answer: The average Gini coefficient for the world in 2015 was **0.3917**. This value indicates a moderate level of income inequality, as the Gini coefficient ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (maximum inequality). This figure reflects global income distribution trends during that year.
